page.overview:
Who is Agent Wessom?

Agent Wessom is an employee of the Department of Labor.

Charles Montgomery Burns recently sent Charlie off to an Arabic Palace due to one of his many elaborate traps. He hires Zutroy, a replacement for Charlie. However, a group of agents from the Department of Labor scale from the ceiling. From here, Wesen and the other Department of Labor Female Agent issue demands.
